claims.claim_ar: إِلَّا هنا أداة حصر تقيّد المعنى العام في «وما من دابّة...»، فتجعل الآية استثناءً يوضّح أن الرزق محصور بالله.
claims.claim_en: The particle إِلَّا here functions as an exclusory particle (hasr/qaṣr), restricting the general negation in 'وما من دابّة...' and making the exception that sustenance (رزق) is entrusted solely to God.

claims.claim_ar: الواو في بداية الآية (وَمَا) تعمل كأداة وصل تربط الكلام السابق بالآية، وتُسهم في سلاسة الانتقال بين الجُمل والمعنى العام للخطاب.
claims.claim_en: The initial conjunction واو (in وَمَا) functions as a connective conjunction (wa-), linking discourse and contributing to smooth transition between clauses in the verse.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source is a grammatical commentary noting 'الواو عاطفة'; classification as the rhetorical device 'fasl_wasl' (as opposed to purely grammatical conjunction) should be reviewed by a specialist in classical rhetoric.

warnings: Source chunks provided are mainly lexical and grammatical (Darwish I'rab, Zamakhshari) and do not include explicit discussions by all named rhetoricians (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha). Claims are therefore conservative and based only on substrings actually present in the supplied chunks.

Some rhetorical attributions (e.g., treating conjunctions as rhetorical 'fasl_wasl') border on grammatical description in the available sources; such attributions have been marked with lower confidence and a needs-review note.
